requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and role-based access control to protect attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization and low-energy communication protocols for accurate attendance tracking.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall store historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support compliance and analysis.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and data integrity.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall ensure attendance reports generated for administrators include anonymized data to protect student identities.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms and resource management to minimize energy consumption.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
